about: Shapes of an opening. A batch of hooks uses at least three, so the user picks an angle, not a wording. Each shape is a starting point, never a template to fill blindly.

archetypes.name: Contrarian
archetypes.shape: Everyone thinks [X]. It is [Y], and here is the proof.

example.spoken: Your $300 grinder is why your coffee tastes worse.
example.visual: two cups side by side, price tags on

archetypes.risk: highest ceiling and highest variance: the video must prove the claim or trust collapses

archetypes.name: Investigator
archetypes.shape: I found a [hidden thing] in [familiar place] that does [unexpected thing].

example.spoken: There's a setting in your camera app that fixes shaky video.
example.visual: thumb opening the settings, zoom on one toggle

archetypes.risk: safe baseline, fewer flops, lower peaks

archetypes.name: Experimenter
archetypes.shape: I did [X] for [time] to find out [Y].

example.spoken: I posted every day for 30 days. Here's what moved.
example.visual: a calendar flipping, a views counter climbing

archetypes.risk: the effort must be visible in the first frame

archetypes.name: Teacher

example.spoken: She doubled her bookings with one line on her menu.

archetypes.risk: slides into a lecture if the method is not named fast

archetypes.name: Magician
archetypes.shape: Look at this. [The picture surprises; the words only point.]

example.visual: a full glass turned upside down, nothing spills

archetypes.risk: a weak picture leaves nothing; the words carry little

archetypes.name: Fortuneteller
archetypes.shape: [Thing] is about to change how [audience] [does action].

example.spoken: In a year nobody will edit captions by hand.
example.visual: captions writing themselves on a timeline

archetypes.risk: needs a real demo of the change or it reads as hype

archetypes.name: Result first
archetypes.shape: Open on the finished thing, then walk back to how.

example.visual: the finished room, then a rewind to the empty one

archetypes.risk: the result must be striking on its own

archetypes.name: Specific number

example.spoken: I burned $413 on coffee gear so you can skip to the $39 one.
example.visual: a pile of gear, then one small device

archetypes.risk: a fake or rounded number reads as made up
archetypes.source: Dickie Bush's big-number leads, general craft

archetypes.name: Callout
archetypes.shape: If you [exact situation], this is for you.

example.spoken: If your reels stall at 300 views, it's the first frame.
example.visual: a phone with a 300-view reel, thumb hovering

archetypes.best_for: a narrow audience with a known pain
archetypes.risk: a broad callout ('if you want to grow') calls nobody

archetypes.name: Authority + gap
archetypes.shape: I've [real experience]. The real [answer] isn't [common answer].

example.spoken: Eight years as a barista. The upgrade isn't the machine.
example.visual: apron, hands on a cheap maker

archetypes.risk: false authority is worse than none

archetypes.name: Side by side

example.visual: split screen, left dull, right sharp

archetypes.risk: the difference must read at thumbnail size

archetypes.name: Goal first
archetypes.shape: The decisive moment on frame 0, the context after.

example.visual: the ball already flying toward the top corner

archetypes.risk: spoils the ending: keep a second moment for the payoff

archetypes.name: Save or miss
archetypes.shape: Freeze before the outcome: will it go in?

example.visual: a striker mid-shot, the keeper still on the ground

archetypes.risk: the outcome must be shown, never withheld to the end

archetypes.name: Controversial call
archetypes.shape: The disputed moment, then 'penalty or not?'
archetypes.risk: invites comments; keep it about the play, not people

archetypes.name: Stat shock
archetypes.shape: [A number nobody expects] + the play that made it.

example.spoken: Eleven shots, zero on target, then this.
example.visual: a stats graphic, cut to the goal

archetypes.risk: the number must be true and checkable

archetypes.name: Prediction

example.spoken: They lose on Sunday, and here's the reason.
example.visual: a weak spot in their defence, circled

archetypes.risk: never promise results; no betting claims or odds as certainty
